+# Data Protection Notes
+
+This document records what personal or sensitive data God's Eye View handles,
+where it is stored, and how long it is kept. It is maintained alongside the
+source code so that it stays current with every change.
+
+## 1. Overview
+
+God's Eye View is a real-time situational-awareness dashboard built from
+**public** data feeds. It does not collect, store or process personal data
+about its users beyond what is described below. It does not hold dossiers on
+natural persons.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Data categories and flows
+
+### 2.1 Live feed data (aircraft, vessels, satellites, earthquakes, fires, cyclones)
+
+| Item | Origin | Personal data? | Storage | Retention |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| Aircraft positions, callsigns, ICAO 24-bit addresses | ADS-B public feeds (ADS-B LOL, OpenSky Network) | Callsigns can link to registered operators (not individuals) | In-memory only (server process) | Evicted after ≤ 60 s (rolling cache); not written to disk |
+| Vessel positions, MMSI, names, destinations | AIS public broadcast (AISStream) | Ship names and destinations are broadcast by operators, not individuals | In-memory only (server process) | Evicted after ≤ 60 s; not written to disk |
+| Satellite TLE elements | Space-Track (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL ≤ 1 hour; not written to disk |
+| Earthquake events | USGS public earthquake feed | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 5 min; not written to disk |
+| Fire hotspot data | NASA FIRMS (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 5 min; not written to disk |
+| Cyclone advisories | GDACS (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 5 min; not written to disk |
+| METAR weather reports | aviationweather.gov (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 10 min; not written to disk |
+
+All in-memory caches are process-local; they are not shared with any external
+service and are discarded on server restart.
+
+### 2.2 CCTV / street-camera stills and streams
+
+| Item | Origin | Personal data? | Storage | Retention |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| Camera still images (JPEG/PNG) | Public municipal and traffic feeds (City of Austin, Transport for NSW, Tallinn, Warendorf, etc.) | Images show public spaces and may incidentally contain images of people in public places | Proxied on request; not cached to disk | Not retained; each image is fetched on demand and streamed to the browser |
+| HLS live-stream segments | Same public feeds | Same | Not cached; proxied in real time | Not retained |
+
+The server acts as a **pass-through proxy**. It does not persist, log, or
+analyse camera imagery.
+
+### 2.3 Terrain elevation data
+
+| Item | Origin | Personal data? | Storage | Retention |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| Elevation samples (HGT tiles) | SRTM/ASTER public datasets | None | Disk cache at `server/data/terrain/` (read-only; shipped with the repository) | Permanent (static reference data); no runtime writes |

events.text: Summary of all changes made:**
Package 1 — Static security analysis in CI

`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**: Added `security-events: write` permission and a new `semgrep` job that runs the Semgrep GitHub Action with the `p/default`, `p/javascript`, and `p/nodejs` rule packs, uploads a SARIF report to GitHub Security tab, and does not block the main build.
Package 2 — Unsafe HTML sinks
`src/intel/index.js`**: Removed the unused `html` / `innerHTML` parameter from the local `el()` helper, eliminating the raw HTML sink entirely (no callsite ever passed an html argument).

`src/shell/index.js`**: Replaced the raw `if (html != null) node.innerHTML = html` assignment in `el()` with a DOMParser-based parse (`text/html`), ensuring that even if a non-literal were ever passed, embedded scripts could not execute. Also removed the redundant `layer.name` html argument from the layer-name span (textContent is set immediately afterward on the next line anyway).
`src/shell/welcome.js`**: Added a minimal `escHtml()` helper and used `safeBuildId = escHtml(BUILD_ID)` in the innerHTML template to sanitize the build-time environment variable before insertion.
Package 3 — Encrypted transport / HTTPS enforcement
`server/providers/cctv/constants.js`**: Changed `http://webcam.warendorf.de/` → `https://webcam.warendorf.de/` in the `WARENDORF_IMAGE_ORIGINS` allow-list.

`server/providers/cctv/sources.js`**: Reworded the JSDoc comment to avoid a literal `http://` URL (the comment explains that plain-HTTP catalog URLs are upgraded; the wording now does not embed the scheme).
`server/providers/metar.js`**: Changed the dummy URL-parsing base `'http://local'` → `'https://local'` (never used for network access; just needed by the URL constructor).
`server/providers/terrain.js`**: Same — `'http://internal'` → `'https://internal'`.
Package 4 — Data protection notes

`DATA_PROTECTION.md`** (new file): Comprehensive record covering all data categories (live feeds, CCTV stills, terrain, API keys, access logs), storage locations, retention periods, third-party processors, data-subject rights, and security controls. Includes a review schedule.

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [24.14.0, 26.x]
    env:
      PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      GEV_REQUIRE_ALLOCATION_GATE: ${{ matrix.node == '24.14.0' && '1' || '0' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run setup policy checks
        run: npm run doctor -- --json

      - name: Check adopted formatting
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Check package boundaries
        run: npm run check:boundaries

      - name: Check traceability and orphan code
        run: node scripts/audit/trace-check.mjs && node scripts/audit/import-graph.mjs

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        if: matrix.node == '24.14.0'
        run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=critical

      - name: Build production bundle
        run: npm run build

      - name: Smoke-test the preview server
        run: node scripts/preview-smoke.mjs

  semgrep:
    name: Static security analysis (Semgrep)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run Semgrep
        uses: semgrep/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: >-
            p/default
            p/javascript
            p/nodejs
          generateSarif: '1'
        env:
          SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload SARIF results
        if: always()
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: semgrep.sarif
        continue-on-error: true

# Data Protection Notes

This document records what personal or sensitive data God's Eye View handles,
where it is stored, and how long it is kept. It is maintained alongside the
source code so that it stays current with every change.

## 1. Overview

God's Eye View is a real-time situational-awareness dashboard built from
**public** data feeds. It does not collect, store or process personal data
about its users beyond what is described below. It does not hold dossiers on
natural persons.

---

## 2. Data categories and flows

### 2.1 Live feed data (aircraft, vessels, satellites, earthquakes, fires, cyclones)

| Item | Origin | Personal data? | Storage | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aircraft positions, callsigns, ICAO 24-bit addresses | ADS-B public feeds (ADS-B LOL, OpenSky Network) | Callsigns can link to registered operators (not individuals) | In-memory only (server process) | Evicted after ≤ 60 s (rolling cache); not written to disk |
| Vessel positions, MMSI, names, destinations | AIS public broadcast (AISStream) | Ship names and destinations are broadcast by operators, not individuals | In-memory only (server process) | Evicted after ≤ 60 s; not written to disk |
| Satellite TLE elements | Space-Track (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL ≤ 1 hour; not written to disk |
| Earthquake events | USGS public earthquake feed | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 5 min; not written to disk |
| Fire hotspot data | NASA FIRMS (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 5 min; not written to disk |
| Cyclone advisories | GDACS (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 5 min; not written to disk |
| METAR weather reports | aviationweather.gov (public) | None | In-memory only | Cache TTL 10 min; not written to disk |

All in-memory caches are process-local; they are not shared with any external
service and are discarded on server restart.

### 2.2 CCTV / street-camera stills and streams

| Item | Origin | Personal data? | Storage | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Camera still images (JPEG/PNG) | Public municipal and traffic feeds (City of Austin, Transport for NSW, Tallinn, Warendorf, etc.) | Images show public spaces and may incidentally contain images of people in public places | Proxied on request; not cached to disk | Not retained; each image is fetched on demand and streamed to the browser |
| HLS live-stream segments | Same public feeds | Same | Not cached; proxied in real time | Not retained |

The server acts as a **pass-through proxy**. It does not persist, log, or
analyse camera imagery.

### 2.3 Terrain elevation data

| Item | Origin | Personal data? | Storage | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Elevation samples (HGT tiles) | SRTM/ASTER public datasets | None | Disk cache at `server/data/terrain/` (read-only; shipped with the repository) | Permanent (static reference data); no runtime writes |

### 2.4 Provider API keys (server-side secrets)

| Item | Where stored | Who can read it |
|---|---|---|
| AISStream API key | `.env` file on the server host | Server process only; never sent to browser |
| FIRMS API key | `.env` file on the server host | Server process only |
| OpenSky credentials (optional) | `.env` file on the server host | Server process only |
| Google server-side API key | `.env` file on the server host | Server process only |

`.env` files are git-ignored and must not be committed to version control.

### 2.5 Browser-visible tokens

| Item | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Google Maps API key (`VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`) | Compiled into the browser bundle | Must be HTTP-referrer-restricted in Google Cloud Console |
| Cesium Ion token (`VITE_CESIUM_ION_TOKEN`) | Compiled into the browser bundle | Must be domain-restricted in the Cesium ion dashboard |

These are **not secrets** in the traditional sense; they are visible in browser
devtools. Restrict them by referrer/domain at the provider to limit abuse.

### 2.6 Server access logs

The development/demo server (Node.js `http.createServer`) does **not** write
access logs. No IP addresses, request URIs or user-agents are recorded to disk.

The optional per-IP rate limiter holds a counter in memory (keyed on the
client's IP address as seen by the server). This data is process-local and
discarded on restart. No IP is logged to disk.

---

## 3. Data subject rights

The system holds no personal data about users or third parties beyond what is
described in section 2 (all transient, in-memory only). There is nothing to
export, correct, or delete in response to a data-subject request beyond
shutting down the server (which discards all in-memory caches).

---

## 4. Third-party processors

| Provider | Purpose | Privacy policy |
|---|---|---|
| ADS-B LOL (adsb.lol) | Aircraft positions | https://adsb.lol/privacy |
| OpenSky Network | Aircraft positions | https://opensky-network.org/about/privacy-policy |
| AISStream | Vessel AIS data | https://aisstream.io/privacy-policy |
| NASA FIRMS | Fire hotspot data | https://www.nasa.gov/privacy |
| USGS Earthquake Hazards | Earthquake events | https://www.usgs.gov/privacy-policy |
| GDACS | Cyclone advisories | https://www.gdacs.org |
| aviationweather.gov | METAR reports | https://www.weather.gov/privacy |
| Cesium ion | 3-D terrain and imagery tiles | https://cesium.com/legal/privacy-policy |
| Google (Maps Platform) | Geocoding, tiles, search | https://policies.google.com/privacy |

---

## 5. Data minimisation and security controls

- The browser never receives raw API keys for server-side providers.
- Camera imagery is proxied, not stored; only the requesting browser receives it.
- All feed strings (ship names, callsigns, place names) are HTML-escaped before
  rendering to prevent injection (see `src/intel/markup.js`; regression-tested
  in `src/intel/markup.test.mjs`).
- All external traffic uses HTTPS. Plain-HTTP origins in camera source lists are
  upgraded to HTTPS before fetching.
- Rate limiting is applied to proxy endpoints to reduce quota abuse risk.
